utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all. Monday the third, quick stand-up and then I'll let you crack on. Everyone alright?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, alive. Bit damp getting in though, typical. Weekend was decent till the rain turned up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mm, same here. Proper summer, innit.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Supposed to clear later, apparently. I was gonna do the garden, ended up hiding indoors watching rubbish telly.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Better than me staring at whoever's got the new car in the car park. Big shiny thing by the side gate, very flash.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not yours then, no?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I wish, mate. If it was mine I wouldn't be in at half six.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes Top Gear. Callum, production first?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, lines came back alright overall. Minor hiccup on packing but nothing dramatic. Team's in, no absences on days.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Anything carrying over?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not from me as a fresh job, no. Just keeping an eye on rates on line 1.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Davey?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning. Mechanically we're not too bad. Walked the utilities first thing. No new failures overnight.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Air side's a bit grubby as usual, but manageable.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm. Tomasz, anything from maintenance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing major from nights handover. Couple of usual call-outs, all closed. I can support wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Morning. Process-wise line 1's still limited because we're still waiting on parts for the line 1 TCU, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's blocked then, not one for today. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, no major drift. Scrap looked normal on the last run.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. Controls side, I signed off the inspection on the turbine one gas valve on Tuesday, so that's done already, not for today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the CV01 last night, so that's off the board as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Only blocker my side, still waiting on parts for the line two, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Also just an observation, noticed the big boiler was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so I just want it in the room, not asking for anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, logged. Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Morning. Stores is okay. Deliveries due before eleven if traffic behaves.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I did see the pressure on the Compressed Air Dryer dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just an observation really.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the turbine two water valve but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cancelled, leave that alone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, actions then. Aisha, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 mould temp this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 mould temp this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one, Davey — can you swap the filter on the air compressor at half two? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I'll swap the filter on the air compressor at half two.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll just need it kept clear for twenty minutes or so.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's fine, I'll make sure ops stay off it around then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect. On the turbine one gas valve, fairly important, by the 28th I need to go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine one gas valve.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You taking that yourself then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do it. I'll go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine one gas valve by the 28th. Fairly important, just so it doesn't drift.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the collection note if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, send it over after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And same sort of thing, fairly important, I'll write up the near miss at the palletizer first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah that wants closing out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie's one — what about the stretch wrapper?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the stretch wrapper after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You sure? I can give you a hand if it's proper wedged.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: If it turns into a wrestling match, yeah, but I'll start with it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, let's leave Jamie to take first look after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're on safety bits, the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 does want checking tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 tomorrow. Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Tomorrow I'm tied up on the PMs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I've got trials in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'm offsite first half.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not really my lane, to be honest.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've got panels and then vendor call, so not me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So it needs doing, just nobody's grabbing it right now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, noted as needing doing tomorrow, but nobody's taking it in here yet. We'll sort cover separately.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Anything else live on line 1 apart from the TCU wait?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, once the sign-off's done on the line 1 mould temp this afternoon we're as far as we can go till those parts land.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And line two still the same story, waiting on parts, dead in the water till then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Brilliant. Love a parts shortage.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Keeps life exciting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm, let's not get too excited. Any access issues for half two on the air compressor?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, I'll get the area clear before Davey goes in.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers. If someone can leave me the permit pad nearby, that'll save me a lap.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll stick one on the bench for you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Aisha, any dependency for the line 1 mould temp sign-off?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, just need the line isolated and the paperwork. Straightforward enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On the stretch wrapper, if the sensor face is filthy again I'll clean it there and then. Not making another job of it, just while I'm there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: By the way, boiler trend looked normal again by end of shift, so I wouldn't panic on that warm spell.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, just monitor.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anything from stores on the late courier, Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Should be here today, but that's just delivery status, not an action for anyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Recap then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha will do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 mould temp this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey will swap the filter on the air compressor at half two, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the turbine one gas valve by the 28th, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll write up the near miss at the palletizer first thing tomorrow, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie will clear the jam and check the sensors on the stretch wrapper after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the one still unowned: check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 tomorrow — needs doing, nobody assigned in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks all, let's get on with it.
